description: This file is a shell script that sets up internationalization (i18n) support for Git by configuring gettext. It defines environment variables, chooses an appropriate gettext scheme based on system capabilities, and sources or defines functions for translation.

methods.name: eval_gettext
methods.description: Provides a fallback implementation of the eval_gettext function when gettext.sh is not available, calling gettext and processing the output.

methods.name: gettextln
methods.description: Wraps gettext call and adds a newline for convenience.

methods.name: eval_gettextln
methods.description: Wraps eval_gettext call and adds a newline.
